compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. mwcc emits three destructor variants from the one out-of-line definition -- D1, D0, D2 -- but the cartridge carries only D1 (0x020ff420) and D0 (0x020ff444), which are adjacent: 0x020ff444 - 0x020ff420 = 0x24, exactly D1's size, so the image has no room for a D2 between them. dScMgPachinko2_c is a leaf -- include/dScMgPachinko2_c.h records that no RTTI record names it as a base -- so its own D2 is never odr-used. _ZN16dScMgPachinko2_cD2Ev appears in no symbols.txt and no delinks.txt anywhere in the tree, so it has no ROM home at all: plain deadstrip rather than deadstrip-duplicate, and production isolation discards it.

The class's own vtable, emitted because this TU owns the key function. Extent corroborated two ways that agree: (a) the address point in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt is 0x0213dbbc and the next data symbol is data_ov006_0213dc4c, giving symbol extent 0x90 = 36 slots and STORAGE 0x0213dbb4..0x0213dc4c = 0x98 once the 8-byte offset-to-top and typeinfo preamble is counted; (b) tubuild verify reports the emitted .data section for this symbol as exactly size=0x98. The cartridge keeps its canonical copy at ov006:0x0213dbbc, outside this TU's only licensed range (.text 0x020ff420-0x0210428c), so dsd delinks it from the cartridge independently and discarding this object's copy cannot cost the image a byte. romdata_check compares the emitted copy against the cartridge, relocations applied, before production isolation discards it.
